blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Policy-shift distillation reuses the difference between a teacher's log probabilities before and after reinforcement learning (RL) as supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, this endpoint policy shift cannot reveal whether local action preferences evolved consistently during teacher training. The same endpoint shift can result from early and late shifts that reinforce or partially cancel each other. We investigate whether agreement between early and late teacher policy shifts can guide selective transfer. We introduce Waypoint-guided On-Policy Distillation (Waypoint-OPD), which uses an intermediate teacher checkpoint from the same RL run to compare early and late shifts in relative action preferences at student-visited prefixes. We gate the endpoint shift according to the directional agreement between the early and late shifts, suppressing it when they point in opposing directions. Compared with endpoint-only transfer, our method requires only one additional frozen-teacher scoring pass. Using RL-trained Qwen3-4B teachers, we evaluate our method with Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, and Qwen3-30B-A3B as student models in mathematical and code reasoning. In all six domain--student settings, Waypoint-OPD achieves the highest domain-average score among the compared distillation methods. Ablations with the Qwen3-8B student show that removing or shuffling gates reduces mathematical reasoning performance. These results support the use of directional agreement between early and late teacher policy shifts to weight the endpoint shift during student training.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Reinforcement learning can improve language-model instruction following using rewards learned from human preferences ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ) , and mathematical and code reasoning using verifiable rewards ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) . The latter requires repeated generation, verification, and optimization of on-policy responses. Reusing a teacher’s RL improvements offers a way to share this training effort across target models. This raises the question: which local changes in the teacher’s policy should guide a student on its own generated
trajectories?
blocks.zh:
强化学习可以采用从人类喜好中汲取的奖励(Ouyang等人,2022年)和通过可核查的奖励进行数学和代码推理(Shao等人,2024年;Guo等人,2025年;Yu等人,2025年)改进语言模式教学。 后者要求一再生成、核查和优化政策对策。 重新使用教师的RL改进为在目标模式中分享这一培训努力提供了一个途径。 这引起了一个问题:教师政策中的哪些地方变化应指导学生自己产生
轨迹?

blocks.en:
Standard on-policy distillation (OPD) trains the student to match the teacher’s token distributions on student-generated prefixes ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ) . Its supervision remains tied to the teacher’s absolute policy and capability limitations.
On-Policy Delta Distillation ( OPD 2 ) uses the change between a reasoning-tuned teacher and its base model, retaining token-level signals when the centered change agrees in sign with the centered standard distillation signal ( Heo et al., 2026 ) . Direct On-Policy Distillation (Direct-OPD) focuses on RL-induced improvements. It uses the log-probability ratio between pre-RL and post-RL teacher checkpoints as a dense implicit reward on student-generated states, transferring the teacher’s policy change without matching its absolute distribution ( Feng et al., 2026 ) . Both methods extract changes from a pair of teacher models, but neither directly measures whether consecutive changes during teacher RL point in compatible directions.

blocks.en: The Initial-to-Final log-probability ratio captures only the change between the teacher’s policies before and after RL training. The same endpoint signal can arise from early and late policy changes that point in similar or opposing directions. Endpoint-only transfer cannot distinguish these cases. We hypothesize that agreement between the early and late changes provides evidence for deciding how much weight to assign an endpoint shift at a student-generated prefix.
blocks.zh: 初始到最终的对数概率比率只记录教师在RL培训前后的政策变化。 早期和晚期的政策变化可以产生相同的终点信号,这些变化指向类似或相反的方向。 只有终点的转移无法区分这些情况。 我们假设,早期和晚期变化之间的协议提供了证据,可以确定在学生产生的前缀上分配一个终点位移的分量。

blocks.en: Building on this hypothesis, we propose Waypoint-OPD, which uses agreement between consecutive teacher shifts to gate the endpoint transfer signal. We retain three checkpoints from the same teacher RL run: Initial before RL, Waypoint at an intermediate RL step, and Final at the end of RL. At each student-generated prefix, we select its top- k k most probable next-token candidates. Over these candidates, we compare how the teacher’s relative preferences change from Initial to Waypoint and from Waypoint to Final. Their agreement gates the centered Initial-to-Final signal, retaining aligned changes and suppressing reversals. Waypoint thus supplies evidence for weighting the endpoint shift, which remains the transferred signal. Relative to endpoint-only transfer, this requires one additional frozen teacher scoring pass, with no new teacher training or verifier calls during student transfer.
blocks.zh: 基于这个假设,我们提出Waypoint-OPD,它使用连续的教师班次之间的协议,到端点传输信号门. 我们保留了来自同一教师RL运行的三个检查站:RL之前的初始点,中间RL步骤的Waypoint,最后在RL末尾. 在每一个学生产生的前缀, 我们选择它的顶级 -- kk 最有可能的下一位候选人。 与这些候选人相比,我们比较教师的相对偏好如何从初始点到Waypoint,从Waypoint到Final。 它们的协议打开了中枢初始到最终的信号,保留了对齐的更改并压制了逆转. 因此,Waypoint为加权端点移提供了证据,端点移仍然是转移信号. 相对于端点单调,这需要再加一个冻结的教师积分卡,在学生转校期间没有新的师资培训或核查员电话.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are: • Temporal agreement as a criterion for selective transfer. We use the Waypoint checkpoint to assess temporal agreement at student-generated prefixes, revealing directional information unavailable from the endpoint pair alone. • Waypoint-guided gating of endpoint signals. We develop Waypoint-OPD, a dense on-policy objective that uses this agreement to weight the endpoint signal at each student-generated prefix, with one additional frozen teacher scoring pass. • Higher average performance across domains and model sizes. We evaluate Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, and Qwen3-30B-A3B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) on mathematics and code. Waypoint-OPD achieves the highest recorded domain average among the evaluated baselines in all six settings
(Figure 1 and Tables 1 and 2 ). Ablations on Qwen3-8B mathematical reasoning support the value of temporal gating
(Table 3 ).

blocks.en: 4.1 Models, data, and evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.1 模式、数据和评价

blocks.en:
For each domain, we use three checkpoints from the same Qwen3-4B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) RL run: Initial ( π 0 \pi_{0} ) before RL,
Waypoint ( π m \pi_{m} ) at RL step 600, and Final ( π 1 \pi_{1} ) at RL step 1200. Math and code teachers use non-thinking RL. All three checkpoints remain frozen during transfer.
We train Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, and Qwen3-30B-A3B students using the teacher’s RL-induced policy shifts. These students span three scales and dense and MoE architectures within one family with compatible tokenizers. The transfer objective does not require the teacher to outperform the student. We report all three teacher checkpoints and the Base students in the result tables to show pre-transfer performance.
blocks.zh:
对于每个领域,我们使用来自同一Quen3-4B(杨等人,2025年)的3个检查站,RL运行:初始(π0\pi_{0})在RL,
Waypoint (π m\pi_{m}) 位于 RL 阶600, 最终 (π 1\pi_{1}) 位于 RL 阶1200. 数学和密码老师使用不思考的RL. 所有三个检查站在移交期间仍然冻结。
我们利用教师引发的RL政策转变来培训Qune3-8B,Qune3-14B,以及Qune3-30B-A3B学生. 这些学生跨越三个尺度,在一个家庭内用兼容的标致器建造密集的教育部建筑。 转学目标并不要求老师优于学生. 我们在结果表中报告所有三个教师检查站和基地学生,以显示移交前的表现。

blocks.en:
Math transfer uses DAPO-Math-17K prompts ( Yu et al., 2025 ) . We evaluate on seven benchmarks: AIME 2024, AIME 2025, AIME 2026, HMMT February 2025, HMMT November 2025, HMMT February 2026, and AMC 2023. For each problem, mean@32 measures
average correctness over 32 generated responses. Benchmark scores average these values over problems, and Avg. is the unweighted mean across benchmarks.

blocks.en:
Code transfer uses a Codeforces-derived prompt set. Evaluation uses the 378-problem MBPP+ set from EvalPlus ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , reporting both the original MBPP tests ( Austin et al., 2021 ) and the original plus additional tests (MBPP+), together with LiveCodeBench v4, v5, and v6 ( Jain et al., 2025 ) .
We report mean@8 , which averages correctness over eight generated responses per problem and then over the problems in each benchmark. Code Avg. is the unweighted mean over these five evaluation scores. Within each benchmark, methods share prompt templates, decoding parameters, maximum generation lengths, and sample counts.

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en:
Knowledge distillation transfers teacher distributions or generated sequences ( Hinton et al., 2015 ; Kim and Rush, 2016 ) , while on-policy variants supervise student-generated trajectories ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ) . Complementary work refines divergence objectives and the use of teacher- and student-generated
data ( Wen et al., 2023 ; Gu et al., 2024 ; Ko et al., 2024 ; Ko et al., 2025 ) . Weak-to-strong generalization asks whether weaker supervision can elicit stronger capabilities ( Burns et al., 2024 ) . WSPO and proxy-tuning reuse a weak
model’s adaptation contrast for training and decoding, respectively ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) .
Within on-policy training, Direct-OPD transfers an RL-induced policy change through an endpoint log-ratio on student rollouts ( Feng et al., 2026 ) . W2S-OPD constructs a proxy teacher by adding a weak-model logit contrast to student base logits, then minimizes reverse KL on student rollouts. Its contrasts span RL checkpoints, model scales, and correct versus incorrect
hints ( Yu et al., 2026 ) . OPRD uses a centered teacher–reference shift to amplify the component of a verifier-driven gradient along that direction ( Park et al., 2026 ) . Waypoint-OPD builds on Direct-OPD, weighting local endpoint signals by
agreement between shifts before and after a Waypoint checkpoint.

在Waypoint检查站前后班次协议。

blocks.en:
Teacher–student compatibility affects the utility of on-policy supervision ( Li et al., 2026 ) . Prune-OPD uses support overlap for suffix attenuation ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . EOPD uses teacher uncertainty in its entropy-dependent forward KL ( Jin et al., 2026 ) , while PW-OPSD uses token position in its reference-conditioned self-distillation ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . OPD 2 gates sampled-token updates by sign agreement between centered teacher–base and teacher–student advantages ( Heo et al., 2026 ) , whereas RG-OPD gates trajectories using agreement between verifier-derived advantages and teacher–student sequence log-likelihood gaps ( Akhondzadeh et al., 2026 ) . Waypoint-OPD uses different evidence: consecutive shifts in the teacher’s own RL trajectory over student-supported candidate actions. Their weighted directional agreement produces a prefix-level gate for the dense endpoint
update, without verifier feedback during transfer. This agreement is a weighting criterion, not a guarantee of correctness.

OPD 2门通过中心教师-基地和教师-学生优势(Heo等人,2026年)之间的签定协议,抽取了最新数据,而RG-OPD门采用核查者-衍生优势和教师-学生序列类日志差距(Akhondzadeh等人,2026年)之间的协议。 Waypoint-OPD使用不同证据:教师自己的RL轨迹连续改变,而不是学生支持的候选人行动. 他们的加权方向协议为密集端点制造了前缀级门
更新,在传输时没有核查反馈。 这一协议是一个加权标准,而不是正确性的保证。

blocks.en:
A teacher’s final performance need not determine its teaching utility: early stopping and intermediate checkpoint selection can improve distillation ( Cho and Hariharan, 2019 ; Wang et al., 2022 ) . Pro-KD and progressive distillation use successive teacher checkpoints
as targets or a curriculum ( Rezagholizadeh et al., 2022 ; Panigrahi et al., 2025 ) .
Direct-OPD also studies RL checkpoint choice for transfer ( Feng et al., 2026 ) . For fixed Initial and Final endpoints, Waypoint measures directional consistency between the two shifts. It supplies neither an imitation target nor a curriculum. The centered Initial-to-Final shift remains the transferred object.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Waypoint-OPD, which uses agreement between consecutive teacher shifts to transfer RL-induced policy changes. An intermediate Waypoint checkpoint reveals whether early and late changes in relative action preferences reinforce or oppose each other at student-generated prefixes. This information, unavailable from endpoint differences alone, determines the weight of the centered Initial-to-Final shift in the student’s on-policy objective. The method requires one additional frozen-teacher scoring pass and no verifier calls during transfer.
Experiments on mathematical and code reasoning show gains over endpoint transfer across three Qwen3 student scales. Ablations on Qwen3-8B math support prefix-specific gate assignment and batch-scale normalization. These findings suggest that intermediate teacher checkpoints provide evidence for weighting local policy changes during student learning.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了Waypoint-OPD,它利用连续教师换班之间的协议来转移RL引发的政策变化. 一个中间Waypoint检查点揭示了相对动作偏好早期和晚期的变化在学生产生的前缀中是相互加强还是相互反对. 仅从端点差异来看,这一信息就决定了学生政策目标中以中心为中心从初始到最终转变的权重。 这种方法需要增加一个冻结的教师评分证,在调职期间没有核查员打电话。
关于数学和代码推理的实验显示,在结束点转移之后,跨越三个Quen3学生尺度。 Qwen3-8B数学支持前缀专用门派和批量级正常化上的调用. 这些调查结果表明,中级教师检查站为学生学习期间衡量地方政策变化提供了证据。

blocks.en: Figure 5 compares rollout generation over the same 100 training steps. Response length is the mean number of tokens per rollout response at each training step, and response truncation rate is the fraction of rollout responses reaching the maximum length of 16,384 tokens. Waypoint-OPD has a lower mean response length at 87 of the 100 steps and a lower response truncation rate at 62 steps, with equal rates at 18 steps. Averaged uniformly across the 100 steps, the response truncation rate decreases from 14.83% for Direct-OPD to 11.97% for Waypoint-OPD, a reduction of 2.86 percentage points. These results show that Waypoint-OPD produces shorter responses at most training steps and reaches the response-length limit less frequently on average.
